column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way I Wouldn't Help My Little Sister
You... What did you just say...?
You didn't hear me? I said "Those kind of people can't be my friends".
What are you saying!!
Don't make me repeat myself. Or are you so dim-witted that you don't understand Japanese?
This isn't about me! How could you say such things about Saori and Kuroneko when they're so worried about you?!
I-I'm free to choose whatever I want to say...
Hey... you're not serious, are you?
You're so untrusting... You're unpopular because of that, you know?
We're not talking about me right now, are we?
Oh, really... But I'm serious.
I'll say it as many times as I have to. I can't accept that such people are my friends.
If you're going to continue being like this, they will be very troubled!
They have a year's worth of memories with you! Do you think it's okay to ignore that one year just for yourself?
T-That's...
...Hey.
Huh? I didn't hear you?
Kirino... You...
I have no memories of meeting them anyway. Frankly, I'm not troubled in any way if I can't remember, you see?
Kirino...
Is there anything wrong with what I've said?
Certainly, that may be the case for you... However, for those two...
Tch...
...It doesn't matter any more. All right, this discussion's over～
You... are not Kirino.
...Huh?
Didn't you hear me? I said I'm not acknowledging you as Kirino.
I-I'm not myself...? But I am myself.
Damn... So in the end, I couldn't do anything...?
This discussion ends here. All right, meeting dismissed!
I told you the real Kirino wouldn't say something like that!
Huh?  Everything you said has been nonsense since a while ago.
Guh... This girl...
What are you glaring at? Do you have any complaints?
Why do I have to talk this much with a mere stranger like you?!
Quiet! Since it's come to this, I'm not going to give in!
I will absolutely make you remember your true self!
A-Are you stupid?!
It's true that until a year ago, I was just like a stranger to her. It's only natural that Kirino resists against me.
*sigh*... Just don't get involved with me any more, I beg you.
Just stop it already! I'm fed up with being dragged around by you!
Until you recover your memory, I'll keep dragging you around. After all, I'm your older brother!!
O-Older brother... I-I told you that's gross!
What do you mean the real me... I am myself... How many times must I tell you to make you understand...
Because the memories that you're throwing away are definitely a part of the real you!
W-What kind of pointless argument are you trying to make?
Like I said, I don't need memories of being an otaku...
So you'll give up just like that?
The Kirino Kousaka that I knew wouldn't give something up once she has her heart set to do it. With or without memories, that part is the same.
So that's why if you were to give up right here, you're not Kirino Kousaka.
...Y-You don't even understand anything about how I feel!
What... Say something!
No... Because it's useless to talk any further, right?
Wha-?!
Even if I'm gross or annoying, I'm still your brother. That's something that won't change no matter how much you hate me.
Anyway, there's only one Kirino! And I am myself! I'm fine with this!
...It's not right... Not the slightest bit.
Argh, you're way too persistent! Cut it out already!
